Thanks again for the partnership this past year. - Reserved Dedicated pool: add 4 additional A100-equivalent GPUs (bringing total to 12 GPUs reserved)
- Throughput guarantee: baseline 6k tokens/sec across the pool (SLO included in SOW)
- Term: 12 months committed + optional 12-month auto-renew

List pricing for the expansion is $85k/month (proforma) and there’s an onboarding/engineering ramp credit available separately. I understand procurement needs a discount to get buy-in — Bluefin asked for a 30% credit during renewal. Our standard play for renewals of this size is to offer a graded credit in exchange for a longer commit.

Can you confirm the internal timeline for signature? If you’re able to commit to 12 months now (vs month-to-month), I can escalate for a one-time renewal credit. My ask from your side: target PO by 04/30 so we can schedule the Dedicated pool capacity on our planning window.

Next steps I propose:
1) Confirm PO timeline and billing entity
2) We’ll route credit approval to finance/leadership (I’ll loop internal folks)
3) If approved, we’ll send DocuSign with redlines and SLA attachments

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call if that helps.
